_what: Signal-detection tuning for the ASMR pipeline. NOT brand values — nothing here comes from or belongs in brand/tokens/. Brand values enter the video engine only through scripts/brand_profile.py.
_why: Phase 2D was validated on synthetic clips. Every constant below was tuned against exponentially-decaying white-noise bursts, which are NOT real tactile audio. Naming them here makes the calibration delta measurable instead of a diff against buried literals.

synthetic-v1._status: APPROVED — IMPLEMENTATION. Validated on synthetic clips only.
synthetic-v1._caution: Do not treat these numbers as correct for real footage until a calibration run says so.

envelope._note: 20 ms windows at 8 kHz. Ample for transient onsets; keeps the skill dependency-free.

silence._risk_on_real_footage: Real room tone raises the measured floor. floor_multiplier=2.2 may then sit ABOVE quiet handling noise, classifying real tactile content as silence. This is the dangerous direction: it over-cuts and destroys the rhythm the format exists to protect.

events._rule: threshold = max(median * median_multiplier, peak * peak_fraction, floor * floor_multiplier); a window must also rise by rise_ratio over its predecessor
events._risk_on_real_footage: Real footage has continuous room tone and handling noise, so the median is much higher relative to transients than in synthetic audio. median_multiplier=3.0 may then exceed real peels entirely — under-detection. A single loud snap also inflates peak, so peak_fraction=0.18 can mask every softer event in the clip.

scene._risk_on_real_footage: Handheld camera motion and lighting change can trip scene detection where there is no cut, suppressing hero windows that are genuinely stable content.

hero._note: Widened from 2.0 during synthetic testing because generated bursts landed 1.1–2.6 s apart. Real tactile activity clusters far more densely; this may want narrowing.

plan._rule: Every transient reserves pre_roll before and tail after. A silence overlapping a reserve is never trimmed. A kept run shorter than min_segment is MERGED with its neighbour, never discarded.
plan._risk_on_real_footage: tail_s=0.45 was set against a synthetic decay envelope. A real room has reverb; a real peel decays differently. Too short truncates the decay — the single most audible way to ruin an ASMR cut.
